parsedVerdict.reasoning: The file is declared in the domain layer (it matches the **/*.entity.ts pattern), but OrderEntity is a TypeORM persistence model. The class-level decorator @Entity('orders') maps the class to a database table. @PrimaryGeneratedColumn('uuid') sets how the database generates keys, and the @Column() decorators map fields to table columns. Table mapping and key generation are persistence concerns, so they belong to the infrastructure layer, not the domain layer. The file contains no domain behaviour or business invariants. Its one method, hasId(), only checks whether the ORM has assigned an id, which is also a persistence-lifecycle concern. The rubric names persistence logic in a domain file as a failure, so this file fails.
